verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents two-way SMS on the business number through its dashboard and mobile app on Business Plus. Separately, it lets a business share its number with the team and add users, which implies the team can reach the texts. No evidence shows a shared team inbox for texts or attribution of which teammate replied. missing for 10: documented shared/team SMS inbox, per-user reply attribution, conversation assignment or visibility controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Send and receive texts with customers through your dashboard or mobile app. (Business Plus)
